input.quote: ARTICLE XXI EFFECT OF TERMINATION Upon termination of this Agreement: for any reason (a) the rights and licenses granted to Licensee pursuant to this Agreement will automatically terminate, and (b) Licensee shall, within five (5) days, ship to Licensor all Licensed Technology, API's Documentation with respect to the Licensed Technology and other Confidential Information in Licensee's possession or control, and an officer of Licensee shall certify in writing that Licensee as complied with the provisions of this Section.
input.rationale: There is no transition-assistance or data-return provision anywhere in the Agreement. Article XXI (Effect of Termination) runs one way only: our licences end immediately and we must ship all Licensed Technology, Documentation and Confidential Information to Licensor within five days with an officer's certificate, with nothing requiring Licensor to return or export our data or to assist with migration. Article XX (change of control / wind-up) provides for immediate or automatic termination, and Article X confidentiality likewise only addresses Licensor material, so on termination we could be cut off with no copy of our data — walk-away territory under the rule. We inserted the playbook's preferred exit clause in Article XXI: up to six months of transition assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, return of Licensee Data within thirty days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and deletion certified in writing after that return. The 90-day assistance / 30-day export fallback is available if pressed.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and Licensee Data return/deletion obligations in Article XXI.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XXI only requires us to ship Licensor's materials back and is silent on our own data, so we have added a reciprocal exit clause: six months of transition assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, return of Licensee Data within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and certified deletion after return. We can fall back to 90 days of assistance and export within 30 days.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (a) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days, return all data submitted by or on behalf of Licensee or processed for Licensee under this Agreement ("Licensee Data") in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) after such return, delete Licensee Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.
